$comment: Advisories a person has reviewed and judged unreachable in the shipped app. Read by scripts/audit-triage.mjs and scripts/check-release.mjs. A high or critical finding is accepted only when every high or critical advisory it traces to is listed here, at the severity recorded, before its reviewBy date. A critical advisory can never be listed, and reviewBy may be at most 184 days after acceptedOn, so an acceptance lapses rather than lingering. The reasoning lives in SECURITY.md's exposure notes.

accepted.reason: Reaches the project only through the Expo CLI (expo > @expo/cli > zod, an old copy Expo pins) and through ESLint's react-hooks plugin as a dev-only copy. Both read this repository's own config, not user input, so the memory exhaustion needs an oversized input nobody supplies. Not imported by the app's source and not expected in the Android or iOS bundle. The only fixed zod is 4.6.6 or newer, which Expo's CLI cannot take; npm's only offer is a downgrade to Expo 51.
